boundary: Edge + synthetic Capacitor fixture; not PhotoKit or native-device execution

results.name: manual refresh: old snapshot cannot resurrect a confirmed deletion
pending deletion: individual recovery cannot contradict an in-flight system operation
manual refresh: permission denied during enumeration closes the sheet and old library
out-of-order enumeration: a newer limited result wins over an older full result
permissions: full → limited → full restores the currently permitted totals
persistence: discard survives real page reload and undo restores its exact prior state
permission denied at launch: no library enumeration or destructive request
cloud contract: offline preview reports failure and a later successful retry shows the image
permission ordering: confirmed deletion cannot discard a pending revocation result
